The additional ordinary total norm is zero. Retain every prescribed selected integral unimodular fan and the original strictly contracting scalar domain. These objects have the original six-sphere topology through the full F46 source/cap and common-blowup maps. The holomorphic automorphism group of each such marked object is exactly its faithful physical \(\mathbb C^*\). Every holomorphic scalar endpoint fixes the original base \(t\), has positive affine linear part on the regular two-tori, and has equal original scalar values at its two ends. Its possible integer scalar windings are exactly \[ J_0\mathbb Z,\qquad J_0=\frac{mh}{b}. \] At a fixed winding the full holomorphic endpoints differ precisely by the extending physical scalar. This classification includes both root caps and their complete reference words. Retain the rational positive-\(G\) line operator \(U\), the actual reference constants \(C_a,c_0\), and the full original identities \[ B_0=C_a\frac q{t^3}U^{-b},\qquad h_0=c_0q^\varepsilon t^{-mn_0}. \] On \(\lambda=r^{mh}\), the primitive forward endpoint is \[ E_r=\gamma_0r^{-\varepsilon J_0}t^{d_0}U^\varepsilon, \qquad d_0=\frac{3\varepsilon-mn_0}{b},\qquad \gamma_0^b=c_0C_a^{-\varepsilon}, \qquad r\longmapsto\zeta_b r. \] Its inverse is evaluated at the actual inverse source point. Its \(b\) chronological copies give exactly \(h_0B_\lambda^{-\varepsilon}\), with all original constants retained. The complete K67 parameter-family comparison is the physical map \[ F_r=r^{\varepsilon J_0(b-1)/2},\qquad F_{\zeta_b r}E_r= \exp\!\left(\frac{\pi i\varepsilon J_0(b-1)}b\right)E_rF_r. \] The exponent is integral on every displayed domain. The original family is the literal degree-\(b\) pullback of the completed shorter family over \(w=r^b\), \(\lambda=w^{J_0}\), including both caps, the selected Cox maps, physical line, stable tangent and all seams. For one positive primitive scalar circle, the initial physical pair \((k_{\rm phys},\ell_{\rm phys})\) and index \(S_0\) are \[ \begin{array}{c|c|c|c} (a,b)&k_{\rm phys}&\ell_{\rm phys}&S_0\\ \hline (1,6)&kl&4kl&0\\ (2,3)&2l(4k+1)&8l(k+1)&kl\\ (3,2)&9k(3l+2)&12k(l+2)&k(4l+2)\\ (6,1)&18(3l+2)(4k+1)&24(kl+2k+l+1)&35kl+22k+8l+5. \end{array} \] The actual held-quaternion native pair is \[ (\mu,\nu)=(\ell_{\rm phys}/4,\, k_{\rm phys}-\ell_{\rm phys}/4). \] For the vertical fan \(T_j\), the full primitive data are \[ S_j=S_0-\frac{J_0}{2}j(j-1),\qquad k_j=k_{\rm phys}-3J_0j(j-1),\qquad \ell_j=\ell_{\rm phys}. \] For every selected lattice-basis fan \(P\), the complete terminating algorithm RJC.78--80, equivalently the full native maps and nine-variable target systems JFP.41--43, gives its actual integer return \(S(P)\). This includes every full source coefficient, original height, ordinary product, physical normal and cap reset. Every holomorphic scalar path of winding \(sJ_0\) and every holomorphic closing at that winding has return \(sS(P)\pmod{28}\) on its prescribed fan. Conversely every integer \(s\) is attained by the explicit shorter-family annular pullback. The exact images over all selected fans and all such paths are \[ \begin{array}{c|c|c} (a,b)&\text{holomorphic winding group}& \text{complete all-fan return image}\\ \hline (1,6)&2kl\mathbb Z&kl\mathbb Z/28\\ (2,3)&l(4k+1)\mathbb Z&l\mathbb Z/28\\ (3,2)&2k(3l+2)\mathbb Z&k\mathbb Z/28\\ (6,1)&(3l+2)(4k+1)\mathbb Z&\mathbb Z/28. \end{array} \] For the positive seam \((x,1)\sim(\Phi(x),0)\), the oriented mapping torus is \[ (S^1\times S^6)\mathbin{\#}\Sigma_{sS(P)}. \] The inverse seam gives \(\Sigma_{-sS(P)}\). For each of the two spin structures the corresponding Eells--Kuiper values are \(sS(P)/28\) and \(-sS(P)/28\) in \(\mathbb Q/\mathbb Z\). The two signed sphere equations retain the same positive scalar parameter orientation throughout these statements. All assertions retain the four stated root progressions, their original norm representatives, every finite character, full annular reference and selected fan. The scope is the fixed original source and zero additional ordinary total norm.

source_row.statement: Retain the original OS45 marked source and point line \[ \begin{gathered} R=t^2+a,\qquad f=R^2+t,\qquad g=R^3+\frac32tR+\frac38,\\ y^2=x^3-3fx+2g,\qquad G=(R,\sqrt3/2),\qquad \mathcal M=\mathcal O([8G]-[O]), \end{gathered} \] with source translation by \(-G\), selected whole nodal fibre at \(t=t_c\), and original height \(q_{\rm sel}=t-t_c\). Retain the original order-one cap at \(t=0\), its positive norm \(\psi(\widehat\gamma)=1\), every prescribed source and physical integer in its full period reference, every prescribed integral lattice-basis selected fan, and an original admitted fixed nonzero scalar \(\lambda\). On the original ordered selected-source cover \[ a=-u/3-u^4/9,\qquad t_c=1/(2u)-u^2/3,\qquad v^2=4u^3+3, \] the ordinary-cap collision locus consists of exactly twenty-four marked points: \[ \begin{gathered} 16a^3+3=0,\\ 2187-16u^3(u^3+3)^3 =-(2u^3-3)(8u^9+84u^6+342u^3+729)=0. \end{gathered} \] Each of the twelve distinct \(u\)-values has two distinct ordered \(v\)-values. The six points with \(u^3=3/2\) have \(t_c=0\); the other eighteen have \(t_c\ne0\). These two loci and the other excluded source boundaries have the disjointness and full local coordinate inverses proved in OC45.1--2 and ORC.1--2. Every positive meridian at any of these twenty-four marked points, closed by its actual original source, line and cap-reference endpoint, has \[ [\Phi]=0\qquad\text{in }\Theta_7=\mathbb Z/28. \] Every inverse meridian has the same zero class through the reciprocal source, Cartier, cap, endpoint and transport maps. The comparison giving this return is an explicit family map. At each collision let \(s=t_n(a)\) be the actual moving nodal value, with \(s(a_*)=0\) and \(ds/da=-2a_*\ne0\). Its full source chart has \(XY=t-s\), the inverse \[ t=s+XY,\qquad y=(X+h_nY)/2,\qquad 2(x-\xi)\sqrt{x+2\xi}=h_nY-X, \] and the complete functions \(\xi,h_n\) of OC45.8--11. In the actual point coefficient \(V=f_{P^8}(Z;Q)v_M\), the original periods are \[ h:(Z,V)\longmapsto(QZ,P^8V),\qquad B:(Z,V)\longmapsto(P^{-1}Z,CV),\qquad C=\lambda(t-t_c)\beta . \] Here \(Q=(t-s)\kappa\), \(P\), \(\beta\), the fixed Hom normalization, and all higher coefficients remain the original functions. At the central node, \[ P_*=-2\pm\sqrt3,\qquad \kappa(0,0)=\frac1{288a_*^2},\qquad \beta(0,0)=C_*\frac9{a_*^2}. \] Their full Cartier maps and their target-point inverses occur in the construction. Move the reference cap to the protected ordinary point \(t=d\) by the full based integral and holomorphic comparison OC45.39--56. Its gluing is \[ \mathcal F_w(Z,V)=(e^{-w\log P}Z,e^{w\log C}V),\qquad \Psi_d=\mathcal F_{\log(t-d)/(2\pi i)},\qquad \Psi_d^{-1}=\mathcal F_{-\log(t-d)/(2\pi i)}. \] These maps extend on the original source, point/O modules, infinity components and every prescribed selected fan by OC45.29--35. The resulting family \(Y\) is smooth and proper over the full \(s\)-disc with the original oriented sphere fibre. On the original cap, the complete retained period is \[ \gamma_{\rm ref} =\frac{(-\log P,\log C)}{2\pi i} +k\,\frac{(\log Q,8\log P)}{2\pi i} +r\alpha+d_\delta\delta . \] Its positive parameter jump is \(k\alpha\) at the eighteen unselected-cap points and \(k\alpha+\delta\) at the six selected-cap points. The actual integral preimages, based-cell inverse and Lie-cochain solution carry each of those full jumps. With \(F_\theta:X_\theta\to Y_\theta\) the resulting comparison and \(E_X,E_Y\) the forward marked endpoints, they give \[ F_1E_XF_0^{-1}=CE_Y,\qquad C\in\mathbb C^*_{\rm physical}. \] For the actual transport \(P_Y:Y_0\to Y_1\), the full return identity is \[ F_0\bigl(E_X^{-1}F_1^{-1}P_YF_0\bigr)F_0^{-1} =E_Y^{-1}C^{-1}P_Y . \] The explicit physical isotopy \(e^{\theta\log C}\) and the disc transport prove the stated class with its prescribed endpoint. The argument-preserving radial scalar comparison of OC45.10 carries these same maps to every original admitted fixed scalar. The complete scope is these twenty-four ordinary-cap collision meridians and their inverses.
